title: Evidence sufficiency assessment enables cost-effective review allocation in on-premise clinical AI agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.27390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-premise clinical AI agents must auto-accept high-confidence diagnoses, deferring others to clinician review, yet token probabilities and self-reported confidence miss errors, while more reliable five-run consistency incurs fivefold compute. We propose training-free decision-point evidence sufficiency assessment and a three-tier sequential triage protocol. Masking reasoning and diagnosis, the same 4B model scores sufficiency from objective evidence via prior-debiased probabilities over five ordered levels. Calibration freezes a nominal top-50% threshold, selecting single-run, five-run consistency, or full-deferral tiers by whether the one-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound of pass rate among accepted cases meets the 95% clinical target line. translated_title: 证据充分性评估使本地部署的临床AI智能体实现高性价比的审查分配
translated_abstract: 本地部署的临床AI智能体需要自动接受高置信度的诊断，并将其余病例转交临床医生审查，然而token概率和自我报告的置信度会遗漏错误，而更可靠的五次运行一致性验证则需要五倍的计算量。我们提出了无需训练的决策点证据充分性评估方法及三级顺序分诊协议。通过屏蔽推理过程和诊断结果，同一个4B模型基于客观证据，利用先验去偏概率对五个有序等级进行充分性评分。校准阶段冻结一个名义上的前50%阈值，根据接受病例通过率的单侧95% Wilson下置信界是否达到95%临床目标线，选择单次运行、五次运行一致性或完全转交人工审查的层级。在涵盖MIRA-v2、CDM、VivaBench及院内肝脏恶性肿瘤主要队列的1,605例病例中，MIRA-v2单次运行的前50%通过率达到98.91%，与五次运行一致性验证的效果相当，同时节省约80%的计算量。
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的证据充分性评估方法与三级顺序分诊协议，使本地临床AI智能体仅用单次推理即可达到五次一致性验证的通过率（98.91%），并节省约80%的计算成本。
en_tdlr: A training-free decision-point evidence sufficiency assessment with a three-tier sequential triage protocol enables on-premise clinical AI agents to match five-run consistency pass rates using only single-run inference, saving approximately 80% of compute.
